messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: RStan 2.1.1 corrects issue with Rcpp 0.11.0
parts:
We've just released a new version of RStan to deal
with an issue arising in Rcpp 0.11.0; you should only
need this release if you have upgraded to Rcpp 0.11.0.

As usual, you can find the latest version of RStan along with
install instructions at:

https://github.com/stan-dev/rstan/wiki/RStan-Getting-Started

- RStan Dev Team

messages.author: 0839befa8a8b7d53
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Re: RStan 2.1.1 corrects issue with Rcpp 0.11.0
parts:
I think I've seen this issue. One of the students in my course had a similar error, and we fixed it by rolling back to Rcpp 0.10.6 and rstan 2.1.0. I also had the same problem on my old old old Macbook (10.7.5, Core 2 Duo), fixed it the same way.

Compiler on the old machine is: gcc version 4.2.1 (Based on Apple Inc. build 5658) (LLVM build 2336.1.00)

So if others are suffering the same bug, then these are the relevant files:

http://dirk.eddelbuettel.com/code/rcpp/Rcpp_0.10.6.tar.gz

http://wiki.rstan-repo.googlecode.com/git/src/contrib/rstan_2.1.0.tar.gz

And then install from local source:

install.packages("<path to>/Rcpp_0.10.6.tar.gz",repos=NULL,type="source")
install.packages("<path to>/rstan_2.1.0.tar.gz",repos=NULL,type="source")

Replacing <path to> in both lines above with the path to the folder containing the two source archives.
